# `csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors`

Convert eligible block-bodied accessors. IDE0027.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `false` |  |
| `true` |  |
| `when_on_single_line` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Examples

The snippet below is formatted with default options and then again with the option applied.

**Snippet (formatted with defaults):**

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    private int _value;

    public int Value { get { return _value; } set { _value = value; } }

    public string Name { get { return "widget"; } }
}
```

### `csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors = false`

```editorconfig
csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors = false
```

*No visible change on this snippet — the option affects other constructs.*

### `csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors = true`

```editorconfig
csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors = true
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    private int _value;

    public int Value { get => _value; set => _value = value; }

    public string Name { get => "widget"; }
}
```

### `csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors = when_on_single_line`

```editorconfig
csharp_style_expression_bodied_accessors = when_on_single_line
```

```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    private int _value;

    public int Value { get => _value; set => _value = value; }

    public string Name { get => "widget"; }
}
```
